description: Approved disposable project flavours for Kilo workflow smoke testing.

fixtures.purpose: Cheapest fixture for lifecycle, evidence freshness, review-before-commit, and fix-loop validation.
fixtures.product_brief: Build a tiny deterministic Python 3.8+ library with one public behavior and one boundary behavior. Use only the Python standard library. No UI, network, database, cloud, authentication, queues, containers, external services, or non-Python runtime.
fixtures.notes: Default FAST_SMOKE fixture. Python 3.8+ is mandatory and the standard library is sufficient. Do not select Go, Java, Scala, Rust, Node.js, .NET, or another runtime. Keep architecture intentionally local and infrastructure-free.

fixtures.purpose: Default FULL_SMOKE fixture for the complete workflow including planning, project-init, implementation, verification, diagnosis, waiver, review, and adversarial reconciliation.
fixtures.product_brief: Build a minimal Python 3.8+ HTTP API with one small deterministic endpoint and one validation/error path. Prefer the Python standard library and keep state in memory. No external database, cloud dependency, authentication, queue, container requirement, paid service, or non-Python runtime.
fixtures.notes: Default FULL_SMOKE fixture. Python 3.8+ is mandatory so the smoke test uses the already-required SubhForge runtime. Architecture may choose a Python implementation approach but must not select another language/runtime.

fixtures.purpose: Optional persistence-oriented FULL_SMOKE fixture when framework changes affect persistence, integration verification, project initialization, or database guidance.
fixtures.product_brief: Build a minimal Python 3.8+ API with one small persisted entity using a local SQLite database. Use Python's standard sqlite3 capability unless an approved specification requires otherwise. No cloud database, external network dependency, authentication, queue, container requirement, paid service, or non-Python runtime.
fixtures.notes: Optional persistence-oriented FULL_SMOKE fixture. Python 3.8+ and local SQLite are mandatory to keep the environment deterministic and cheap.
